important_correction: The previous v1 report's 45-question public-pattern finding is invalid for this project and is removed. The project pattern is fixed at 47 main questions, 100 marks, 3 hours 15 minutes, Sections I-XIII, as defined by the project engine and source-paper set.
engine_checks: Deterministic seed is used for each Mock Paper number.
Questions are selected from the merged QuestionBankLoader pool.
Duplicate main questions are blocked within a generated paper by key().
MCQs are restricted to Section I.
Q1-Q6 are required to be MCQs.
Q47 requires a formal-letter choice and an informal-letter choice.
Section XI prefers comprehension passages of at least 600 characters when at least two such candidates exist.
The engine validates 47 main questions and 100 marks.

content_findings_confirmed.finding: composition-batch-01 contains multiple 5-mark essay model answers of only about 5-6 sentences. Other inspected composition banks also contain answers shorter than the Section XII instruction of about 18-20 sentences.
content_findings_confirmed.action: Expand selected/eligible 5-mark essay model answers to approximately 18-20 well-formed sentences while preserving the original topic and answer points.

content_findings_confirmed.finding: Some formal-letter banks omit a complete sender/address/date block, while other banks use a fuller school-exam format.
content_findings_confirmed.action: Standardise eligible formal-letter model answers to sender/address/date, receiver designation/address, subject, salutation, body, complimentary close and name/class where appropriate.

content_findings_confirmed.finding: The loader merges all manifest banks into one pool and the engine relies on metadata/domain classifiers. Therefore malformed or weak bank items can become mock candidates if they satisfy the classifier.
content_findings_confirmed.action: Use the runtime audit harness to identify exact selected items, then correct source-bank records or add targeted overrides.

runtime_audit.purpose: Loads the same manifest, question-bank loader and deterministic blueprint engine used by the app, generates Mock Papers 1-10, and reports exact selected question IDs, OR choices, section counts, marks, duplicates, essay-answer length, letter-format checks and comprehension length.
runtime_audit.current_status: Harness committed; exact browser-generated selections have not been falsely declared audited because this tool session has no JavaScript browser runtime capable of executing the deployed page.
runtime_audit.next_step: Open the audit page from the same GitHub Pages site and run the audit once; the page can download the generated JSON report.
